title: THE CURSE OF CONSTANT AVAILABILITY | The Harsh Reality They Never Tell You #shorts
hook: Being too available is the fastest way to become invisible.
description:
Being too available is the fastest way to become invisible.

Being too available is the fastest way to become invisible. When you respond instantly to every call, solve every crisis, and never say no, people do not appreciate your kindness—they discount your value. Free water is taken for granted until the well runs dry. Human psychology is fundamentally predatory: people only respect what requires effort to obtain. Scarcity creates value; unlimited accessibility creates contempt. If you keep setting yourself on fire to keep other people warm, you will die surrounded by spectators who will complain that you did not burn bright enough. Learn the power of calculated absence. Your presence only matters to those who feel your departure.
